content:
Looking to discover new games for your iPhone and iPad? The App Store has plenty of options with no ads and no in-app purchases.

Apple Arcade is a subscription service suitable for all ages, but it's not the only option. If you're already a Netflix subscriber, you can actually play many excellent iPhone and iPad games.

Your Netflix subscription already includes a large collection of iPhone and iPad games

Every Netflix subscription plan now includes a massive library of mobile and TV games.

This includes the most affordable "Standard with Ads" plan at just $8.99 (approximately HK$70) per month.

No matter which Netflix plan you've chosen, you can already play mobile and TV games with no ads, no in-app purchases, and no extra fees.

For TV games, Netflix offers a dedicated app for iPhone and iPad called Netflix Game Controller.

This app turns your phone or tablet into a game controller to use with supported Netflix smart TV apps. If you want to further enhance your mobile gaming experience, a dedicated iPhone game controller is a great choice.

Netflix also has another iPhone and iPad app called Netflix Playground, which features mini-games designed for kids. Additionally, there's Netflix Puzzled: Logic Games (no subscription required) and Netflix Stories.

Beyond the games mentioned above, Netflix supports over 80 iPhone and iPad games. You can download any of them from the App Store, then sign in with your Netflix email and password to start playing.
